title: Concept: Predictable randomness via mt_rand (php) — review required
description: In php, mt_rand is a statistical generator, not a cryptographic one: observing outputs reveals the state, and default seeds repeat across runs. Security values need unpredictability, which only random_int / random_bytes provides in php.
applicability: php codebases drawing random values through mt_rand; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Guessed session tokens, reset links, and nonces when predictable output guards access; MEDIUM severity, HIGH when the value directly authenticates.
